claims.verbatim:
Ship Wm Frothingham, Qualey, Havre, July 15, with mdse
and 160 passengers, to Boyd & Hincken. July 25, lat 47 34,
lon 25, saw a water logged bark, apparently British, aban-
doned, timber laden, foretopgallant mast gone, courses
furled, foretopsail gone, maintopsail hanging split to the
yard; 5th inst, lat 47 48, lon 40 05, spoke bark Russia (Br),
from Liverpool for Quebec, 37 days out; 12th, lat 47 05, lon
47 48, bark Gesion (Nor), bound E; 16th, lat 42 23, lon 57 20,
ship Diligentia (Br), bound E. The W F has had strong
westerly winds, thick and hazy weather most of the passage;
been 14 days W of the Banks.

The ship Wm. Frothingham, arrived at this port yesterday, reports
July 25, in lat. 47 34, long. 25, saw a water-logged bark, apparently
British, abandoned, timber laden, foretopgallant mast gone, main top-
sail hanging split, to the yard.
